points.description: Identifies at least three distinct pieces of missing information needed to replicate the procedure. Examples: type/concentration of vinegar (e.g., % acetic acid); volume/amount of vinegar in each container; size/shape/surface area of the samples; type/size/material of the containers; temperature/conditions during the 24 hours; type of balance/precision; whether samples are covered; how samples were dried/rinse amount; specific identity of the samples (e.g., type of wood/plastic). Award 1 mark for each distinct valid piece, up to 3. Equivalent wording accepted; repeats of the same idea earn no extra marks.
points.partial_credit: 1 mark per distinct valid piece, max 3.

levels.says: One valid piece of missing information given.
Two valid distinct pieces of missing information given.

rubric.notes: Full marks for three distinct, valid missing details (e.g., vinegar type/concentration, volume of vinegar, sample size/shape, container size, temperature). Each valid piece earns 1 mark. Vague or repeated items, or details already in the procedure (e.g., 24 hours, 30 minutes drying), earn nothing.
